title: Bail Organa
description: The Senator from Alderaan and the husband of Queen Breha, Bail Organa was one of the secret founders of the Rebel Alliance. When Obi-Wan Kenobi hid the Skywalker twins, Bail and Breha took Leia and raised her as their own. After Leia's kidnapping, Bail reached out to Kenobi for aid. Kenobi rescued Leia and eventually saw to her safe return.
